description: Makes the Governed-SDD operator cookbook location-aware and less duplicative. Prompts resolve queue, task, and review-record paths from PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md rather than assuming template paths; the two overlapping design prompts become one; design visibly routes unresolved questions to a bounded SPIKE; and a read-only upgrade-inspection prompt prevents maintenance checks from accidentally invoking adoption or an applying upgrade.
delta: docs/OPERATOR_PROMPTS.md adds a location-resolution preamble, replaces hardcoded tasks/QUEUE.md, tasks/TASK_BLUEPRINT.md, and tasks/reviews/<TASK-ID>.md references with canonical project-declared records, combines 'Design a change or decompose a milestone' and 'Design the next milestone or phase', adds the SPIKE shape to the combined design prompt, and adds a read-only 'Inspect a Meridian framework upgrade' prompt. No normative workflow rule, protected capability text, command behavior, or project-specific document is changed.
verification: The governed-SDD operator cookbook resolves canonical locations from PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md and names meridian locations --project . as an optional resolver
The cookbook no longer hardcodes tasks/QUEUE.md, tasks/TASK_BLUEPRINT.md, or tasks/reviews/<TASK-ID>.md
The combined design prompt names the bounded SPIKE Question, Budget, and non-production Deliverable
The upgrade-inspection prompt runs only meridian upgrade --project . --check and explicitly forbids apply, adopt, and finalize-adoption
